run_dpo_training: run DPO training on a preference dataset with a causal language model using the trl dpo script
run_dpo_lora: run DPO training with LoRA adapters on a preference dataset using PEFT configuration
run_dpo_quantized: run DPO training with 4-bit or 8-bit quantized model on a preference dataset
build_dpo_cli_parser: build an argparse CLI parser for DPO training with model, dataset, and training configuration arguments
run_dpo_with_custom_dataset: run DPO training with a custom dataset loaded via the datasets library streaming mode
